### Valvoline Inc. to Report Financial Results for Fourth Quarter 2026 and Host Webcast on November 19


October 29, 2026


LEXINGTON, Ky.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance, today announced that it plans to report financial results for its fiscal fourth quarter on November 19, 2026. A live audio webcast with analysts and investors will also be held on November 19, 2026 at 9 a.m. ET.


The webcast and slide presentation will be available on the company’s Investor Relations website at[http://investors.valvoline.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.valvoline.com%2F&esheet=54630441&newsitemid=20261029087536&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.valvoline.com&index=1&md5=f2aeb6e787503ff50a27bdbbc479a5e3) . Shortly after the call concludes, a replay of the webcast will be available on this same website.


**About Valvoline Inc.**


Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV) delivers quick, easy, trusted service at approximately 2,500 franchised and company-operated service centers across the United States and Canada. The Company completes more than 30 million services annually system-wide, from about 15-minute stay-in-your-car oil changes to a variety of manufacturer-recommended maintenance services such as wiper replacements and tire rotations. At Valvoline Inc., it all starts with our people, including the 13,500 team members who are working to drive the full potential of our core business, deliver sustainable network growth and innovate to meet the evolving needs of our customers and the car parc. For more information, visit[vioc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.vioc.com%2F&esheet=54630441&newsitemid=20261029087536&lan=en-US&anchor=vioc.com&index=2&md5=2adee8d0aaf8b5e1076fe3f36b382a1d) .
